messages:
ashley_cs: Novum Health asked to onboard a custom summarizer model trained on patient notes (PHI). They want private deployment (VPC) + strict audit logs and key management. Contract renewal in ~3 weeks; customer flagged as at-risk if we don't show progress. Can we scope an intake and safety eval plan?
priya_se: On it. Quick Qs: model size & format? Will they provide a checkpoint or a container? Also do they need Redwood Private (customer-managed infra) or Dedicated?
michael_novum: Michael (Novum): We have a 13B model, PyTorch checkpoint (model.tar.gz) and a small redacted sample set. Prefer private deployment (VPC) for PHI. Timeline is tight — P1 for us.
priya_se: Thanks — 13B is fine. We'll need: artifact upload location (S3), vocab/tokenizer files, sample prompts & expected outputs, and a small held-out eval set (we'll run PHI-leak tests + NER/summary quality). Also confirm allowed external access (yes/no) and KMS details.
nashley_cs: FYI renewal date 3 weeks out; finance flagged potential churn unless we show plan and timeline.
kevin_sre: For Private we need network CIDR, egress rules, and whether they want HSM/KMS integration. Also recommend dedicated capacity if they need predictable latency.
emma_legal: Emma (Legal): We need a data processing addendum + assurance they have rights to the training data. For PHI, we require encryption-at-rest, KMS, and logging retained per our compliance policy.
michael_novum: We can sign DPA. We will provide S3 bucket under their account (s3://novum-onboard). Can we use 8-bit quantization for inference?
priya_se: 8-bit quant is okay but we'll run quality regressions first. For the MVP let's do: 1) private deploy of the model with audit logs 2) run PHI leakage tests (exact-match leakage and K-anonymity checks) 3) summarization eval: ROUGE + clinical NER F1 + hallucination sampling.
priya_se: Example eval commands (what we'll run after ingest):
```
# basic eval run
python eval/run_summarization.py --model s3://novum-onboard/model.tar.gz --eval-set s3://novum-onboard/eval.jsonl --out results.json
```
ashley_cs: Can engineering commit to a POC by EOW next week? That will help the renewal conversation.
kevin_sre: We can aim for a sandbox deploy in dedicated test infra within 5 business days after we get the artifacts + network details. Private prod deploy will need a bit longer (IAM, KMS, baselines).
priya_se: Action items: 1) Michael to upload model + tokenizer + evals to agreed S3 and confirm KMS (michael). 2) Novum to sign DPA (emma/legal). 3) Priya + Kevin to run initial quality & PHI-leak tests and share results. 4) Ashley to coordinate renewal messaging.
michael_novum: I'll upload by EOD today. Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.
devops-bot: Ticket CS-4521 created: "Novum PHI summarizer onboarding" — assign @priya_se @kevin_sre @ashley_cs.
priya_se: Scheduling enablement + intake call — sending calendar invites for tomorrow 10am PT. Please include a technical contact from Novum.
ashley_cs: Noted. I'll loop in account exec for renewal discussion.
kevin_sre: Also: we'll run a small red-team prompt sweep (50 prompts) to check for direct PHI extraction before any canary.
priya_se: Final note — if we hit blockers on private infra, fallback plan: spin up a Dedicated instance in our secure tenancy with equivalent controls, but must be approved by Legal.
michael_novum: Understood. See you on the call.
